example.pinyin: Wǒ jiějie de zhàngfū shì yīshēng.
example.gloss: My older sister's husband is a doctor.

example.hanzi: 我媽媽的生日在下個月。
example.pinyin: Wǒ māma de shēngrì zài xià ge yuè.
example.gloss: My mom's birthday is next month.

example.pinyin: Wǒ jiějie hěn huì zuò cài.
example.gloss: My older sister is really good at cooking.
I have a Chinese class this afternoon.

example.hanzi: 我哥哥每天騎腳踏車上班。
example.pinyin: Wǒ gēge měi tiān qí jiǎotàchē shàng bān.
example.gloss: My older brother rides a bike to work every day.

example.pinyin: Wǒ xiàwǔ yào kǎoshì, yǒu diǎn lèi.
example.gloss: I have an exam this afternoon; I'm a bit tired.

grammar.title: 快要……了 (about to / soon)
grammar.explanation: 用「快要……了」說一件事很快就會發生。「快要」放在動詞前面,句子最後要加「了」。Use 快要…了 to say something is about to happen soon; 快要 goes before the verb and the sentence ends with 了.

examples.hanzi: 我姐姐的生日快要到了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiějie de shēngrì kuàiyào dào le.
examples.gloss: My older sister's birthday is coming up soon.

examples.hanzi: 快要考試了,我要認真讀課本。
examples.pinyin: Kuàiyào kǎoshì le, wǒ yào rènzhēn dú kèběn.
examples.gloss: The exam is coming soon; I'm going to study the textbook seriously.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēge kuàiyào dào jiā le.
examples.gloss: My older brother will be home soon.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.gloss: What are you doing this weekend?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.hanzi: 我姐姐生日,我們家人要一起吃飯。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ jiějie shēngrì, wǒmen jiārén yào yìqǐ chī fàn.
dialogue.gloss: It's my sister's birthday; my family is eating together.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 真好!我快要考試了,還有兩課要讀。
dialogue.pinyin: Zhēn hǎo! Wǒ kuàiyào kǎoshì le, hái yǒu liǎng kè yào dú.
dialogue.gloss: Nice! My exam is coming up; I still have two lessons to study.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ de kǎoshì shì nǎ yì tiān?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 下週三。我哥哥說他會幫我。
dialogue.pinyin: Xià zhōusān. Wǒ gēge shuō tā huì bāng wǒ.
dialogue.gloss: Next Wednesday. My older brother said he'd help me.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.pinyin: Nà nǐ yě yào duō xiūxí ō!
dialogue.gloss: Then you should rest more too!

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ gēge de shēngrì shì xià ge yuè.
sentences.gloss: My older brother's birthday is next month.
My older sister has an exam this weekend.
I don't have class on the weekend.

sentences.pinyin: Gēge de shēngrì wǒ yào qǐng tā chī fàn.
sentences.gloss: On my older brother's birthday I'm going to treat him to a meal.

example.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfú yào liǎng qiān kuài.
example.gloss: This piece of clothing costs two thousand dollars.

example.pinyin: Nǐ zǒu de tài màn le, kuài yìdiǎn.
example.gloss: You walk too slowly, hurry up a bit.
The post office is right next to the bank.

example.hanzi: 我最喜歡的顏色是白色。
example.pinyin: Wǒ zuì xǐhuān de yánsè shì báisè.

vocab.gloss: snow; (literary) to wipe away (a humiliation etc)

example.hanzi: 今天很冷，晚上會下雪嗎？
example.pinyin: Jīntiān hěn lěng, wǎnshàng huì xià xuě ma?
example.gloss: It's cold today; will it snow tonight?

example.hanzi: 我妹妹今年十八歲，還在讀書。
example.pinyin: Wǒ mèimei jīnnián shíbā suì, hái zài dúshū.
example.gloss: My younger sister is eighteen this year and is still studying.

grammar.title: Degree complement: V + 得 + 很/太 + Adjective
grammar.pattern: Subject + Verb (+ Object + Verb) + 得 + 很/太 + Adjective
grammar.explanation: To say how well or how fast someone does something, put 得 after the verb and then a description like 很慢, 很快, 太慢了. If the verb has an object, repeat the verb before 得: 他吃飯吃得很慢。

examples.pinyin: Tā chīfàn chī de hěn màn.
Wǒ mèimei shuōhuà shuō de hěn kuài.
examples.gloss: My younger sister talks very fast.

examples.pinyin: Zhè bān chē kāi de tài màn le.

dialogue.speaker: 小明
dialogue.hanzi: 你看，這件衣服的顏色很漂亮。
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ kàn, zhè jiàn yīfú de yánsè hěn piàoliang.
dialogue.gloss: Look, the color of this piece of clothing is really pretty.

dialogue.speaker: 小文
dialogue.pinyin: Duì, wǒ xiǎng mǎi gěi wǒ mèimei.
dialogue.gloss: Yes, I want to buy it for my younger sister.

dialogue.speaker: 小明
dialogue.hanzi: 太多了吧！旁邊那家店比這家便宜。
dialogue.pinyin: Tài duō le ba! Pángbiān nà jiā diàn bǐ zhè jiā piányí.
dialogue.gloss: That's too much! The shop next door is cheaper than this one.

dialogue.speaker: 小文
dialogue.hanzi: 好，我們去看看。你走慢一點，我的腳很痛。
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo, wǒmen qù kànkan. Nǐ zǒu màn yìdiǎn, wǒ de jiǎo hěn tòng.
dialogue.gloss: OK, let's go take a look. Walk a bit slower, my feet hurt.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ mèimei qí jiǎotàchē qí de hěn màn.
sentences.gloss: My younger sister rides her bike very slowly.

sentences.pinyin: Zhè běn shū yào yì qiān kuài.
sentences.gloss: This book costs one thousand dollars.

sentences.pinyin: Biànlì shāngdiàn zài wǒ jiā pángbiān.
sentences.gloss: The convenience store is next to my house.

example.hanzi: 爸爸每天早上都看報紙。
example.pinyin: Bàba měi tiān zǎoshang dōu kàn bàozhǐ.
example.gloss: Dad reads the newspaper every morning.

example.pinyin: Zhège bāo tài guì le, wǒ bù mǎi.
example.gloss: This bag is too expensive; I'm not buying it.

vocab.gloss: airport; airfield; (slang) service provider for Shadowsocks or similar software for circumventing Internet censorship

example.pinyin: Wǒmen dā jiéyùn qù jīchǎng ba.
example.gloss: Let's take the MRT to the airport.

vocab.gloss: to kick; to play (e.g. soccer); (slang) butch (in a lesbian relationship)

example.pinyin: Dìdi tī dào wǒ de jiǎo le.
example.gloss: My little brother kicked my foot.
My younger brother is eighteen now.
This one costs three hundred dollars.

grammar.title: 太 + 形容詞 + 了 (too ...)
grammar.explanation: 用「太……了」說一件事情多過你想要的,常常帶著一點感覺,像抱怨或驚訝。例如東西的錢很多,就說「太貴了」。在台灣常常還會加「吧」或「啦」,像「太貴了吧!」。

examples.pinyin: Zhège tài guì le, wǒ bù mǎi.
examples.gloss: This is too expensive; I'm not buying it.

examples.pinyin: Jīchǎng lí zhèlǐ tài yuǎn le.
examples.gloss: The airport is too far from here.

examples.pinyin: Bàozhǐ shàng de zì tài xiǎo le.
examples.gloss: The words in the newspaper are too small.

grammar.title: 數字:百 (hundreds)
grammar.explanation: 「百」是一百的百。兩百、三百、五百都可以直接說出來,後面常常加「塊」說錢。一百的「一」不能省,要說「一百塊」。

examples.gloss: This one costs two hundred dollars.
I only have a hundred dollars on me.

examples.hanzi: 去機場的車票五百塊,太貴了。
examples.pinyin: Qù jīchǎng de chēpiào wǔbǎi kuài, tài guì le.
examples.gloss: The ticket to the airport is five hundred dollars — too expensive.

dialogue.speaker: 客人
dialogue.hanzi: 太貴了吧!便宜一點好嗎?
dialogue.pinyin: Tài guì le ba! Piányí yìdiǎn hǎo ma?
dialogue.gloss: That's too expensive! Can you make it a bit cheaper?

dialogue.speaker: 老闆
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo la, sānbǎi kuài gěi nǐ.
dialogue.gloss: OK then, three hundred for you.

dialogue.speaker: 客人
dialogue.hanzi: 謝謝!我弟弟要去機場了,我想買一個送他。
dialogue.pinyin: Xièxie! Wǒ dìdi yào qù jīchǎng le, wǒ xiǎng mǎi yí ge sòng tā.
dialogue.gloss: Thanks! My younger brother is off to the airport; I want to buy one as a gift for him.

dialogue.speaker: 老闆
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo ō, hái yào mǎi bàozhǐ ma?
dialogue.gloss: Sure. Do you also want to buy a newspaper?
